title: Localization and Dubbing, Senior Manager
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Localization & Dubbing will lead the planning, production, delivery, and quality control of localized content and local-language dubbing across Asia & Mena including India, Thailand, Indonesia, Phillipines, Korea, Taiwan & Saudi Arabia. The role will ensure Crunchyroll’s anime content is accessible, culturally relevant, accurate, timely, and consistent with global brand and editorial standards across the region.

You will manage localization and dubbing workflows from prioritization and commissioning through production, review, quality assurance, launch, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Content, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, Creative Services, Communications, Legal, Customer Experience, Data, and external localization and dubbing partners.

This role requires strong cultural judgment, operational discipline, vendor management, and the ability to balance fan expectations, creative quality, launch timelines, and business priorities across a diverse, multi-market region.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

### **Lead Regional Localization and Dubbing**

* Develop and execute localization and dubbing plans across priority markets aligned with content priorities, market demand, launch schedules, and business objectives.
* Lead the planning and delivery of local-language dubbing for priority titles and markets.
* Coordinate dubbing workflows from language and market prioritization through casting, recording, editing, mixing, mastering, delivery, and launch.
* Partner with Content and regional stakeholders to identify titles, languages, release priorities, and localization requirements.
* Ensure localized content supports regional fan growth, engagement, accessibility, discovery, and retention.

### **Own Dubbing Quality and Localization Standards**

* Establish and maintain quality standards for local-language dubs, subtitles, metadata, synopses, artwork, product copy, and other localized assets.
* Lead quality-control processes for dubbing, including linguistic accuracy, cultural appropriateness, pronunciation, terminology, performance, audio quality, timing, and technical specifications.
* Review and resolve quality issues with dubbing studios, translators, editors, voice directors, and other external partners.
* Ensure localization reflects the intent, tone, cultural context, and creative integrity of the original content.
* Maintain regional language, editorial, accessibility, cultural, and brand standards in partnership with global teams.
* Use fan feedback, market insight, performance data, and quality findings to improve standards and workflows.

### **Manage Localization and Dubbing Partners**

* Manage external localization vendors, dubbing studios, translators, voice talent, voice directors, quality-assurance providers, and other production partners.
* Establish clear briefs, scopes, schedules, service levels, quality expectations, review processes, and delivery requirements.
* Monitor vendor performance, capacity, cost, quality, turnaround times, and adherence to agreed standards.
* Build strong working relationships with partners while addressing performance gaps, escalations, and quality issues promptly.
* Support vendor selection, onboarding, evaluation, renewal, and continuous improvement.

### **Drive Operational Execution and Launch Readiness**

* Manage localization and dubbing projects from intake and prioritization through delivery and post-launch review.
* Create clear workplans, milestones, owners, dependencies, approval paths, and escalation mechanisms.
* Coordinate launch readiness with Content, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Creative Services, Communications, Customer Experience, and Operations.
* Ensure localized assets are delivered accurately, on time, and in the required formats for platforms, products, partners, campaigns, and channels.
* Maintain visibility into delivery status, risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and issues affecting launch readiness.
* Support localized content availability across direct-to-consumer, distribution, partner, and à la carte channel experiences where applicable.

### **Build Scalable Processes and Frameworks**

* Develop workflows, templates, quality checklists, standards, and operating procedures for localization and dubbing.
* Improve production efficiency, quality consistency, turnaround times, asset tracking, and cross-functional coordination.
* Establish documentation and reporting that provide visibility into localization coverage, delivery status, quality performance, vendor performance, and open issues.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale regional localization and dubbing operations.
* Share best practices, market learnings, and quality insights across regional and global teams.

**Experience and Qualifications**
---------------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in localization, dubbing, content operations, media operations, post-production, language services, or a related field.
* Experience managing local-language dubbing, subtitling, translation, or other audiovisual localization programs.
* Strong understanding of dubbing production workflows, including casting, recording, direction, editing, mixing, mastering, quality assurance, and delivery.
* Demonstrated experience establishing or applying quality standards for localized content and dubs.
* Experience managing localization vendors, dubbing studios, agencies, translators, voice talent, or production partners.
* Strong project management skills and experience managing multiple titles, languages, markets, timelines, and dependencies.
* Ability to balance creative quality, cultural nuance, fan expectations, launch deadlines, and operational constraints.
* Experience working with Content, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, Customer Experience, and global teams in a matrixed organization.
* Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and execution.
* Comfort working across time zones and with globally distributed teams and external partners.
* Fluency in English is required; fluency or professional proficiency in relevant regional languages is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge and passion for anime, entertainment, and fan communities is a significant plus.

**Why you will love working at Crunchyroll**
--------------------------------------------

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
* Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

title: Manager - Sourcing, Accessories
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

The Manager – Sourcing & Procurement (Apparel) will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling the sourcing and vendor ecosystem for apparel, merchandise, and lifestyle products. The role will drive end-to-end procurement, vendor development, commercial negotiations, quality assurance, production coordination, and inventory planning. Working closely with business leaders and manufacturing partners, the incumbent will establish sourcing processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and support the growth of the Accessories Business.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Manage sourcing of apparel and merchandise categories including T-shirts, oversized tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, jackets, polos, caps, tote bags, bottles, mugs, corporate merchandise, and future product lines.
* Develop sourcing strategies to optimize quality, cost, speed-to-market, and scalability.
* Ensure timely procurement and production readiness for launches and ongoing requirements.
* Support category expansion and new product introductions.

#### **2. Vendor Development & Ecosystem Management**

* Build and manage a network of apparel manufacturers, fabric mills, exporters, private label manufacturers, printing partners, packaging suppliers, and merchandise vendors.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop suppliers meeting quality, capacity, and commercial requirements.
* Develop alternate sourcing options to mitigate supply risks and support business growth.

#### **3. Supplier Relationship Management**

* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Monitor supplier performance through scorecards covering quality, cost, delivery, flexibility, responsiveness, and production capability.
* Conduct regular supplier reviews and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Resolve supply chain, quality, and operational issues proactively.

#### **4. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization**

* Lead negotiations on pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead times, and commercial agreements.
* Develop costing models and supplier comparisons to support procurement decisions.
* Identify and implement cost optimization opportunities while maintaining quality standards.
* Drive procurement savings and support budgeting and purchase planning activities.

#### **5. Quality Control & Product Compliance**

* Coordinate with Product Development and Quality teams to ensure products meet brand standards.
* Review and approve development samples before bulk production.
* Monitor key quality parameters including fabric GSM, composition, shrinkage, stitching, colour fastness, print quality, embroidery, and packaging.
* Manage supplier corrective actions and ensure consistency across production batches.

#### **6. Production Planning & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate with Product, Operations, Warehousing, and Logistics teams on procurement and delivery schedules.
* Manage purchase orders, production timelines, and inventory planning.
* Ensure timely deliveries and minimize stock-outs.
* Track orders from sourcing through final delivery.

#### **7. Supplier Audits & Reporting**

* Conduct factory visits and supplier assessments covering manufacturing capability, capacity, quality systems, compliance, and scalability.
* Drive supplier development initiatives.
* Maintain vendor databases, costing sheets, procurement dashboards, and supplier scorecards.
* Generate procurement reports and analytics to support business decisions.

**Education Qualification**
---------------------------

**Essential**

* Bachelor's Degree in Textile Engineering, Fashion Technology, Apparel Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, or related discipline.

**Preferred**

* MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Retail or Marketing.
* Diploma or Certification in Textile Technology, Apparel Manufacturing, Sourcing, Procurement, or Supply Chain Management.

**General Experience**
----------------------

* 6-12 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, vendor management, or supply chain roles.
* Prior experience in:
  + - Apparel Manufacturing
    - Export Houses
    - Buying Houses
    - Private Label Manufacturing
    - D2C Brands
    - E-commerce Businesses
    - Corporate Merchandise Companies
    - Sportswear or Outdoor Apparel Brands
* Demonstrated experience in vendor development, cost negotiations, and supplier relationship management.
* Proven track record of managing multiple product categories and sourcing projects simultaneously.
* Experience in startup, high-growth, or entrepreneurial environments is highly preferred.

**Preferred Industries**
------------------------

**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**

**What you’ll do**

### **Own the India marketing strategy**

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

### **Create demand that converts**

* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.

title: Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)
description:
**Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)**

**Spiceworks | Cloud Help Desk & Inventory Online**

**The Opportunity**

Spiceworks has been an industry pillar for more than 15 years, cultivating a community of millions of IT

professionals. Its flagship IT Helpdesk product, now Cloud Help Desk (CHD), has evolved from a completely free,

ad-supported solution to a freemium, subscription-based model designed to provide users with an ad-free

experience and additional premium features.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own user acquisition and lifecycle execution across

Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online. This is a high-drive individual contributor role for someone who enjoys

building, launching, testing, and optimizing growth programs directly. You will be responsible for increasing user

acquisition, reactivating lapsed users, engaging active free users, and helping convert qualified users into premium

subscribers.

You will work closely with Product Management, Community, and internal product experts. While product experts

will support deep technical demonstrations and product knowledge, you will own the growth engine—from audience

segmentation and campaign execution through engagement, conversion, and performance measurement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Database Reactivation & Win-Back Funnels: Build, write, launch, and optimize targeted reactivation email

campaigns for historical and lapsed users. Develop messaging that communicates the value of the modernized,

ad-free product experience, ease of setup, workflow efficiency, and minimal operational disruption.

* Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Lifecycle Marketing: Build and manage automated lifecycle campaigns triggered by

user behavior and product-usage milestones. Own the user journey from free sign-up or trial through

engagement, activation, and premium conversion.

* Campaign Development & Optimization: Create segmented, targeted, and multi-channel campaigns using

lifecycle marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Intercom, Marketo, or similar tools. Test messaging, audiences,

timing, and conversion paths to improve acquisition and subscription outcomes.

* Field Marketing, Local Meetups & Roadshows: Plan, coordinate, and host localized user meetups, workshops,

and roadshows designed to re-engage free and lapsed users. Work with existing Spiceworks community

chapters to build local participation and create meaningful user interactions.

* Event-Led Acquisition: Partner with internal product experts to deliver engaging user sessions, ensuring

technical product demonstrations are complemented by clear value messaging and a defined digital conversion

journey.

* Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Community Manager to understand forum

sentiment, identify opportunities within the community, and turn relevant discussions and engagement into

acquisition opportunities.

* Performance & Insights: Track acquisition velocity, engagement, reactivation, free-to-paid conversion, and

campaign performance. Use data and event feedback to identify opportunities, improve campaigns, and provide

actionable insights to Product Management.

* End-to-End Ownership: Take personal ownership of growth initiatives from audience selection and campaign

creation through launch, measurement, optimization, and reporting.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, user acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product-

led growth, or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience building and executing automated lifecycle campaigns using tools such as HubSpot,

Intercom, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.

* Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and

campaign optimization.
